question: Who among the following is a famous Chhau dancer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sadashiva Pradhan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sadashiva Pradhan** is a renowned Chhau dancer from India.
 
• He is particularly known for his expertise in the **Mayurbhanj Chhau** style.
 
• He has been honored with several awards, including the prestigious **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**.
 
• Sadashiva Pradhan has significantly contributed to the preservation and promotion of Chhau dance through performances and teaching.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhau Dance:**

 
 
• Chhau is a traditional Indian dance form that combines martial arts, acrobatics, and storytelling.
 
• There are three main styles of Chhau: **Seraikella Chhau**, **Mayurbhanj Chhau**, and **Purulia Chhau**.
 
• The dance is typically performed during regional festivals, especially during the **Chaitra Parva** festival.
 
• Chhau dance has been recognized by UNESCO as an **Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity**.
 
 
 
• **Mayurbhanj Chhau:**
 
 
• Originates from the Mayurbhanj district in Odisha, India.
 
• Unlike other Chhau styles, Mayurbhanj Chhau does not use masks.
 
• It focuses on intricate footwork, graceful body movements, and expressive hand gestures.
 
• Mayurbhanj Chhau often depicts themes from Hindu mythology and folklore.
 
 
 
• **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award:**
 
 
• India's national academy for music, dance, and drama.
 
• The award is given to artists for their outstanding contribution to the performing arts.
 
• It is one of the highest honors for performing artists in India.
